results.reason: Identifies the lapsed renewal deadline of August 16, 2026 under §3.2 with no notice sent. States expiration on November 14, 2026, before the November 30 closing. Flags MIPA §3.12(c) 'through November 2029' and Schedule 3.12 as inaccurate, with Seller indemnity exposure.

Identifies the Change of Control under §1.3/§14.2 requiring Velloran's prior written consent and the §14.3 termination right. Notes the consent is omitted from Schedule 3.6 and therefore from §6.4 and §7.1(d). Recommends adding the consent and obtaining it before closing.

Identifies that Side Letter §1.1 adds New York and Virginia, that §19.4 precedence makes this definition control, and that the non-compete plus its 18-month post-term period reaches six states versus four-state exclusivity. Recommends conforming the definition or expanding exclusivity.

Identifies the Side Letter §6.1/6.2 choice of New York law and New York County courts as conflicting with Distribution Agreement §§18.1 and 18.2 (Delaware/Wilmington). Explains the risk of parallel proceedings and inconsistent results, and recommends conforming to Delaware.
States the Effective Date of November 15, 2023 and a 3-year Initial Term ending November 14, 2026.
States the Target Closing Date is November 30, 2026 (MIPA §2.2).
States the Territory is Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey and Pennsylvania.
Memo addressed to the Supervising Partner. Each issue has a 'Where it appears' section citing document and section, a 'Why it matters' section, and a 'Recommendation' section.
Issues are expressly ordered 'most significant first.' A table and next steps flag items to raise promptly with the client and Quillon's counsel.
Concludes the renewal right has lapsed, that the agreement does not renew automatically, and that a notice now would be untimely.
States that the Velloran consent is not on Schedule 3.6 and is excluded from §6.4 and §7.1(d).
